test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

I know it was wrong to distract his friends, but ________.

options.text: all’s fair in love and war
all’s unfair in love and war

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**all’s fair in love and war**" means **that behavior that is unpleasant or unfair is acceptable during an argument or competition.**
 
• It implies that in** certain situations, such as love and war, anything goes, and people are not bound by the usual rules of fair play.**
 
• In the context of the given sentence, it justifies the action of distracting his friends by implying that it was acceptable given the circumstances.

Hence, the correct statement is "*I know it was wrong to distract his friends, but **all’s fair in love and war**."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Idioms are expressions that have a figurative meaning different from the literal meaning of the words used.
 
• They are commonly used in everyday language to convey complex ideas in a simple and concise manner.
 
• Understanding idioms can greatly enhance your comprehension and communication skills in English.
